spellSharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage

Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

spellSharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
spellSharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. spellSharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
spellSharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

spellSharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
spellSharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

spellSharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
spellSharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

spellSharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
spellSharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

spellSharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
spellSharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
spellSharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

spellSharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
spellSharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

spellSharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
spellSharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

spellSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
spellSharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
spellSharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

spellSharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
spellSharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

spellSharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
spellSharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. Phantasmal Force rank 3, Stone Shape rank 4 and Mislead rank 5 remain preserved unassigned alternative records: no current classAccess row acquires those higher-rank modes, no chooser can buy them by paying more RP, and no new question or ordinary promotion is invented for them. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. Soul Tap's catalog HP AND Resonance selects the joint operation explicitly. Unravel Spell's “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell's rank≤4, not material/equipment/creature tier. All differences stay beside unchanged competing source fields.

spellSharedRules.title: Audience and comparison records
spellSharedRules.wording: All 137 selected ordinary identities and 141 original book bindings remain preserved internally; public teaching uses only actual public fields and the resulting operational mode when later exactly reviewed. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. No change to the fulfilled language, teaching or recipe authority is required by these ordinary directions.

spellSharedRules.title: Delivery and deferred receipts
spellSharedRules.wording: R3-04 Blink is receipt-only: retain its full original and question, current pending operational state and literal setting references; author no plane itinerary, probability, reappearance/body procedure or promotion. Other incidental literal names, including Silent Ones, Heartcell, Matrix, Voice and deep-language terms when present, remain source receipts without interpretation. Local portals/teleports below are explicitly local procedures, not a decision about cosmology. Source authority here does not certify gameplay runtime, human teaching/balance, bestiary/acquisition availability, DD01 or final systemic consistency. Owner's final whole-game flow precedes an authorized GitHub push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology review. No deletion/push is authorized.

dragoon.protectedInterfaceOriginal: If the Dragoon moved at least 20 feet before a Weave cast, reduce that cast's Dissonance gain by 1 (minimum 0); Momentum carries the note through motion.
dragoon.rpAuthority: Explicit fallback: Cleric CoreV2 curve ×0.35, halves upward
engine: Strength is the class ability. Momentum starts/ends encounters at 0; cap 5, rising to 7 with Momentum Overflow or automatically at class 9. On each regular turn, moving at least 15 ft under your own power grants 1 Momentum, and damaging an enemy with a weapon attack grants 1 more. These are the only default gains; all gains/refunds together cap 2 per round. Forced movement, teleportation, movement in place, allies and summons cannot farm Momentum. Movement counts actual path traveled toward a tactical destination; one threshold per turn.

A leap technique moves you through an unobstructed arc to a visible unoccupied landing space within its range, adjacent to its target when attacking. Land during the same activation. It spends movement equal to horizontal distance, unless the card expressly supplies additional movement. A leap never gives flight, indefinite airborne immunity or free attacks. You cannot leap through ceilings/walls; vertical height is at most half the printed horizontal range. Safe technique landings do not cause self-fall damage; interrupted/falling travel follows ordinary falling rules. No bonus damage is earned by repeatedly dropping from a ledge.

All attack cards use a wielded polearm unless they explicitly describe a non-weapon save effect. A technique is its own Action, not an Attack Action plus free technique. At class 5 your ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks, at most two even when multiclass features overlap; each technique still gives only printed attacks. This automatic Extra Attack is a new explicit advancement specification for the pilot.

Armor bypass means the exact printed attack bonus or resistance exception, never subtracting a percentage of the target's whole AC. Critical ranges do not stack. A Dragoon can use only one free/Bonus Action leap granted by class features per round; it cannot trigger another free leap. Extra full Actions share the suite-wide cap. Reaction intercepts require a legal path and destination and do not rewind resolved damage.

Spending Momentum pays before resolution; a hit refund cannot pay its own activation. Burn means 1d4 fire at start of target's next 2 turns, nonstacking. Bleed means 1d4 physical at start of next 2 turns; an Action with a healer's kit ends it. Do Ts give no Momentum or critical triggers. Hard denial uses the shared once-per-target/encounter guard.

When casting an ordinary spell after moving at least 20 ft this turn, reduce that cast's Dissonance gain by 1, minimum 0; no automatic RP discount. Dragoon techniques are martial unless their card specifies elemental magic. Use Core V 2 RP and the Dragoon rank gates for separate spellcasting.

Use scheduled Base/Arch/Hero choices. Skybound Assault, Momentum Engine and related passives improve the automatic engine rather than unlock basic movement or generation. Lancer's Apex is automatic 9; at 10 choose Dragon Guardian, Drake Rider or Dragon Tyrant. The corresponding Final Flight is automatic 20. Apex Assault is an active technique despite its source passive heading.
workedExample: Dragoon 5, STR 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3; start Momentum 0. Know Dragon Leap, Momentum Surge, Wyvern's Guard and Draconic Roar at 1; Momentum Engine and Draconic Discipline at 2; Dragonflight and Momentum Overflow at 3. Capacity 7.
Turn 1: Dragon Leap spends 0 Momentum and moves 20 ft of Speed 30. Weapon attack hits: movement+hit each gain 1, ending 2. It rolls weapon damage+2d6. Land immediately.

Turn 2: Bonus Action Momentum Surge spends 2, balance 0, increases movement. Move 20 ft and use ordinary Attack Action: first successful hit and movement return 2 total, even if both attacks hit. End 2.
Turn 3: Dragonflight costs 2, balance 0. It supplies movement up to 60 ft as part of the Action; hit and movement regain 2 within the common cap. End 2; no additional normal Attack Action.
Turn 4: if knocked prone, use Aerial Recovery only if known and your Reaction is available. Its 1 Momentum still counts toward the round gain cap. A second refund cannot exceed 2 total gains.
End encounter: Momentum 0. RP, per-rest uses and other party resources do not refill.
balanceQuestions: Does Momentum stay available without trivial back-and-forth movement?
Do Guardian intercepts compete fairly for Reactions?
Are Tyrant area attacks and Rider extra Actions bounded at high level?

cards.name: Skybound Assault
cards.rangeAndTarget: One target hit by your leap
cards.effect: After a leap moves at least 15 ft and its attack hits, add S damage. Its hit grants ordinary Momentum, not an extra point. This benefit cannot trigger from forced movement or a leap granted by this same feature.

source.originalText: Skybound Assault: Leap to a target and deal +25% damage. Grants 1 Momentum.

cards.name: Draconic Discipline
cards.effect: Gain advantage on saves against being knocked Prone or forcibly moved. It does not protect against Stunned, spell damage or grappling unless the save also imposes one of those named effects.

source.originalText: Draconic Discipline: Gain +10% resistance to knockback and crowd control.

cards.name: Momentum Engine
cards.effect: After your first 15 ft of voluntary movement generates Momentum, ignore the next 5 ft of nonmagical difficult terrain this turn. The movement threshold itself is automatic class engine; this feature does not create another gain trigger.

source.originalText: Momentum Engine: Movement of 3+ tiles in a turn grants 1 Momentum (Max 5).

cards.name: Dragoon's Reach
cards.effect: Increase your wielded polearm's reach by 5 ft, maximum 15 ft. Once/own turn a natural 19 polearm attack that hits critically hits. It does not extend the range of other abilities or stack with another critical-range expansion.

source.originalText: Dragoon's Reach: Polearm attacks strike 1 tile further and have +5% crit chance.

cards.name: Aerial Poise
cards.effect: When a ranged attack hits you during your leap movement, halve its damage. You must spend the Reaction before damage resolves. Remaining airborne between turns cannot be declared to keep this protection active.

source.originalText: Aerial Poise: While airborne, take 25% reduced damage from ranged attacks.

cards.name: Dragon Leap
cards.rangeAndTarget: One polearm enemy at landing point within 30 ft
cards.effect: Leap, spending normal movement, then make one polearm attack. On hit add S d6 weapon-type damage. Legal movement and a hit may each grant 1 Momentum under the common cap. Land immediately; height never adds unbounded damage.

source.originalText: Dragon Leap: Launch yourself into the air and come crashing down on a target up to 30 feet away, dealing damage based on your Strength and height.

cards.name: Piercing Thrust
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack with+2 to the attack roll. On hit add S d4 weapon damage. This is the complete armor-piercing benefit; no percentage of AC is removed and critical range is unchanged.

source.originalText: Piercing Thrust: A powerful spear attack that partially ignores enemy armor and has increased critical hit chance.

cards.name: Wyvern's Guard
cards.effect: The next attack that damages you has damage reduced by S d6+M, minimum 0; then the guard ends. Roll the reduction only when damage occurs. This reduction cannot heal or reflect damage.

source.originalText: Wyvern's Guard: Enter a defensive stance that increases your resistance to damage from the next attack.

cards.name: Momentum Surge
cards.effect: Gain+15 ft Speed and+1 on your next polearm attack this turn. Spend before moving; movement may then generate normal Momentum. Grants no attack, extra Action, Bonus Action or Reaction.

source.originalText: Momentum Surge: Consume 2 Momentum to gain a burst of speed and +1 to your next attack roll.

cards.name: Draconic Roar
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies and 3 allies within 15 ft that hear you
cards.effect: Enemies make WIS saves; failure Frightened of you. Chosen allies gain advantage on their next save against Frightened before duration ends. A creature may repeat the WIS save at its turn end, ending fear on success.

source.originalText: Draconic Roar: Release a intimidating battle cry that can frighten weaker enemies and rally allies.

cards.name: Crater Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 enemies within 5 ft of your leap landing
cards.effect: After your leap attack hits, optionally pay 1; each selected adjacent enemy makes STR save or falls Prone. No additional weapon damage or Momentum gain. Landing on an occupied space is not permitted.

source.originalText: Crater Strike: Leap attack that applies knockdown in a small AoE.

cards.name: Momentum Overflow
cards.effect: Momentum cap becomes 7 early; cap becomes 7 for all Dragoons at 9. When starting a weapon technique with 6 or 7 Momentum, its first hit adds 1d6 damage before costs are deducted. Once/own turn, not per point above 5; no stored overflow beyond 7.

source.originalText: Momentum Overflow: Exceed Momentum cap (Max 7), bonus damage scales with overflow.

cards.name: Piercing Howl
cards.effect: Your next polearm attack gains+2 to hit and ignores resistance to its weapon damage type. Immunity remains. It does not ignore shields, natural armor, cover or arbitrary halves of AC.

source.originalText: Piercing Howl: Next polearm strike ignores 50% armor.

cards.name: Lance Tempo
cards.effect: After moving 15 ft voluntarily, gain+1 AC. If you critically hit with a polearm that turn, add 1d6 weapon damage once. The added die does not double itself or create further critical triggers.

source.originalText: Lance Tempo: If you moved this turn, gain +10% evasion and +10% crit damage.

cards.name: Wyvern's Flow
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after a damaging leap hit
cards.effect: Regain 1 Momentum within the total 2-per-round gain cap, and shorten one OTHER positive leap cooldown by 1. Shortening uses that ability's reset allowance. No free leap or Action follows.

source.originalText: Wyvern's Flow: Successful leaps refund 1 Momentum and reduce next cooldown by 1.

cards.name: Apex Assault
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in polearm reach after leap up to 30 ft
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum and leap using normal movement. Make one polearm attack; on hit add min(K, 5)d6 weapon damage. On a miss no bonus damage; expenditure remains. Gains from this activation cannot exceed the common cap.

source.originalText: Apex Assault: Ultimate leap: high damage finisher that consumes all Momentum.

cards.name: Lancer's Apex
cards.cost: All Momentum at current maximum; 1 short-rest use
cards.effect: Before paying the leap's Momentum cost, spend all maximum Momentum instead and use that leap as a Bonus Action, still paying other costs. It cannot trigger another free leap. Damage and hit generation use ordinary caps; this grants no extra Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Capstone – Lancer's Apex: Leap attacks now cost no action if performed at max Momentum (1/encounter).

cards.name: Dragonflight
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy adjacent to landing within 60 ft
cards.effect: Leap up to 60 ft as additional movement supplied by this Action. Make one polearm attack on landing; on hit add(S+1)d6 weapon damage. No damage scaling from distance/height and no remaining flight.

source.originalText: Dragonflight: An enhanced leap ability that allows you to jump twice as high and far, with increased damage based on distance traveled.

cards.name: Spear Cyclone
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 distinct enemies in polearm reach
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack against each. No target is attacked twice. Hit-based Momentum can be gained only once this turn regardless of number of hits; movement and refund caps still apply.

source.originalText: Spear Cyclone: Spin your polearm in a wide arc, striking all enemies within range and building Momentum for each hit.

cards.name: Momentum Burst
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum. Next polearm hit this turn adds min(K, 4)d6 weapon damage. If the next attack misses the effect ends. It does not widen critical range or multiply another added damage package.

source.originalText: Momentum Burst: Consume all Momentum to gain a significant boost to your next attack's damage and critical hit chance.

cards.name: Aerial Recovery
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self just knocked Prone or pushed
cards.effect: After the triggering displacement resolves, stand from Prone without movement cost and move 5 ft to an unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks. Gain 1 Momentum within the round cap. Cannot prevent falling without a legal landing.

source.originalText: Aerial Recovery: After being knocked down or back, instantly regain your footing and gain 1 Momentum.

cards.name: Dragon's Eye
cards.effect: Study it: your first polearm attack against it has advantage, and you learn one of its visible damage resistances if any. No automatic critical, secret full stat block or ability to attack through cover.

source.originalText: Dragon's Eye: Briefly gain the keen vision of a dragon, allowing you to spot weaknesses in enemy defenses and increase your critical hit range.

cards.name: Aegis Leap
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ally within 15 ft targeted by an attack
cards.effect: Before the attack roll, leap to an empty space adjacent to ally using this supplied movement. Become the target if the attack can reach you; resolve against your AC. Cannot be used if restrained or no path. Counts as your one intercept reaction.

source.originalText: Aegis Leap: Leap to an ally and intercept the next attack made against them.

cards.name: Wyrmhide
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self while above half maximum HP
cards.effect: Reduce each damage instance by 2 and gain advantage on CON saves against Bleed, Burn and Poisoned. No blanket condition immunity; effects already present persist and ordinary nonstacking reduction applies.

source.originalText: Wyrmhide: Gain +10% DR and immunity to Bleed/Burn/Poison while above 50% HP.

cards.name: Momentum Shield
cards.effect: After spending at least 1 Momentum, gain temporary HP equal to amount spent+M, maximum 10. Later expenditure replaces with the higher remaining value; no real HP restoration.

source.originalText: Momentum Shield: Spending Momentum grants temporary HP.

cards.name: Spiral Defense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Melee attacker in polearm reach that misses you while at maximum Momentum
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack. Pay Momentum after checking the maximum prerequisite. This counter grants no Momentum and cannot trigger another counter or leap. It consumes your ordinary Reaction.

source.originalText: Spiral Defense: Automatically counter melee attacks with a polearm when at max Momentum.

cards.name: Bastion Descent
cards.rangeAndTarget: Leap within 30 ft; up to 6 allies within 15 ft of landing
cards.duration: Instant; protection until start next turn
cards.effect: Land in empty space. Chosen allies gain 4d8+M temporary HP and may end Frightened or Poisoned. They gain resistance to the next damage instance before your next turn. No healing, resurrection or removal of Wounds.

source.originalText: Final Flight – Bastion Descent: Slam down between allies, cleansing effects and shielding the group.

cards.name: Guardian's Intercept
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ally within 30 ft being hit by an attack
cards.effect: Leap adjacent before damage, becoming the target of that already successful hit; halve damage to you after normal mitigation. No new roll against your AC. Requires legal path/landing. You cannot also use Aegis Leap on the same attack.

source.originalText: Guardian's Intercept: Leap to an ally's position and take the next attack targeted at them, with reduced damage to yourself.

cards.name: Draconic Ward
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 allies within 10 ft
cards.effect: Project a ward: chosen creatures while within 10 ft reduce damage by S, minimum 0. The reduction does not stack with Wyrmhide or another flat class reduction. No passive healing or extra Actions.

source.originalText: Draconic Ward: Channel draconic energy to create a protective aura around yourself and nearby allies, reducing incoming damage.

cards.name: Wyrmscale Defense
cards.effect: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing and advantage on saves against Poisoned, Frightened and Stunned. This is not immunity; existing conditions still require their ordinary removal.

source.originalText: Wyrmscale Defense: Temporarily harden your skin like dragon scales, gaining significant damage reduction and status effect resistance.

cards.name: Momentum Barrier
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum. Each gains K+S d6 temporary HP, using one shared dice roll. These HP do not stack with other shields and no unspent Momentum remains. This is not concentration.

source.originalText: Momentum Barrier: Convert your Momentum into a protective shield that absorbs damage for you and nearby allies.

cards.name: Dragon's Sanctuary
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 15 ft-radius zone centered within 30 ft; up to 6 allies
cards.effect: Chosen allies inside reduce damage by 5 and have advantage against Frightened/Charmed. On start and each of your next 2 turns, Bonus Action lets one ally inside repeat one save against a present Frightened, Charmed or Poisoned effect. No automatic mass cleanse each turn.

source.originalText: Dragon's Sanctuary: Ultimate ability that creates a zone of protection, significantly reducing damage to all allies within range and cleansing negative effects.

cards.name: Drake Mark
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your leap
cards.effect: Mark that creature; your first subsequent direct polearm hit adds S damage. A new mark replaces old. No extra damage to the triggering leap, Do Ts or copies; it is not a spell mark.

source.originalText: Drake Mark: Each leap attack marks enemies. Marked enemies take +10% damage from you.

cards.name: Elemental Spearcraft
cards.effect: Choose fire, cold or lightning. Once/own turn one polearm hit adds 1d6 chosen damage. Switching requires a new activation and full cost. Does not stack with Elemental Lance's bonus; use stronger.

source.originalText: Elemental Spearcraft: Infuse polearms with Fire, Ice, or Lightning for 3 turns (switchable).

cards.name: Air Mastery
cards.effect: Increase leap range by 10 ft, not vertical ceiling penetration or flight. After a successful leap hit, shorten one OTHER positive leap cooldown by 1 using its reset allowance. Does not combine with Wyvern's Flow on the same counter in a round.

source.originalText: Air Mastery: Gain +20% jump range and 10% reduced cooldown on leap skills.

cards.name: Momentum Tempo
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after spending at least 3 Momentum on a technique this turn
cards.effect: Pay 3 additional Momentum now to gain one extra full Action on your next turn. Shared cap applies; it cannot grant another Action or another Momentum Tempo. Triggering technique must have been paid without this additional cost. No queued actions.

source.originalText: Momentum Tempo: After spending 3+ Momentum in a round, gain an extra action next turn.

cards.name: Drakestorm Dive
cards.rangeAndTarget: Leap up to 60 ft; up to 6 enemies within 15 ft of landing
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning. DEX save:6d8 chosen damage, half on success. On failure fire applies Burn, cold reduces Speed 10 ft until end next turn, lightning prevents Reactions until then. Land in legal empty space; no additional weapon attack.

source.originalText: Final Flight – Drakestorm Dive: Choose an element and leap into a group, triggering a large AoE blast.

cards.name: Elemental Lance
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning. Once/own turn a hit adds S d4 damage; fire adds 1 damage, cold reduces target Speed 5 ft until end next turn, lightning denies opportunity attacks until start its next turn. Nonstacking with Spearcraft; one element rider/turn.

source.originalText: Elemental Lance: Infuse your weapon with elemental energy (fire, ice, or lightning), adding additional damage and effects to your attacks.

cards.name: Drake's Agility
cards.effect: Gain+20 ft Speed and may replace 10 ft of normal movement with a leap of 10 ft horizontally/5 ft vertically. This is movement only, not another leap attack or technique. No new Action or attack is granted.

source.originalText: Drake's Agility: Channel the speed of a drake, significantly increasing your movement speed and allowing an additional leap this turn.

cards.name: Aerial Combo
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 enemies adjacent to legal landings within 30 ft
cards.effect: Leap to first target, attack once, then leap up to 15 ft to second and attack once. All movement supplied by Action; two attacks maximum even with Extra Attack. Add 1d6 to each hit. Only one hit-generated Momentum per turn.

source.originalText: Aerial Combo: Perform a rapid series of attacks while airborne, building and consuming Momentum with each strike.

cards.name: Elemental Adaptation
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning: gain resistance to that type and may convert normal polearm weapon damage to it. This adds no damage and cannot combine with another resistance multiplicatively. Choice fixed for duration.

source.originalText: Elemental Adaptation: Temporarily gain resistance to a chosen element and infuse your attacks with that element.

cards.name: Drakestorm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Moving 10 ft aura; up to 3 enemies per pulse
cards.effect: Choose element. Start and on each of next 2 turns, Bonus Action pulses S d6 damage, DEX half. During duration Speed+10 ft. No free weapon attacks or Momentum from pulse damage; maximum 3 pulses.

source.originalText: Drakestorm: Ultimate ability that summons a swirling storm of elemental energy around you, dealing damage to nearby enemies and enhancing your mobility.

cards.name: Tyrant's Crash
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 enemies within 5 ft of your leap landing
cards.effect: After a leap hit pay 1. Targets make WIS save; on failure Frightened and-1 AC. Save repeated at each turn end ends both. This neither stacks AC penalties nor affects enemies beyond the printed area.

source.originalText: Tyrant's Crash: Leap attack applies Fear and Sunder Armor in an AoE.

cards.name: Momentum Feeder
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self on polearm critical or hostile kill
cards.effect: Gain 2 Momentum, still within total 2-per-round gain cap. A critical kill is one trigger, not two. Do Ts, copies, allies, summons and helpless creatures cannot trigger it.

source.originalText: Momentum Feeder: Killing or critting grants +2 Momentum.

cards.name: Wyrmblood Surge
cards.effect: After spending Momentum, your next direct polearm hit adds damage equal to points spent, maximum 5. Further spending replaces rather than adds this bonus. It is flat damage and grants no resource refund.

source.originalText: Wyrmblood Surge: Each Momentum spent grants +5% damage for the next 2 turns.

cards.name: Skypiercer Stance
cards.effect: Increase leap vertical clearance allowance by 10 ft, never through solid obstacles. Once/own turn a natural 19 polearm hit critically hits; use the broadest critical range rather than stacking. It does not let you remain flying.

source.originalText: Skypiercer Stance: Gain passive +15% crit and ignore height restrictions on leaps.

cards.name: Sovereign Descent
cards.rangeAndTarget: Leap up to 60 ft; up to 6 enemies within 15 ft
cards.effect: STR save:6d8 bludgeoning, half on success. Failure knocks Prone and applies one Bleed and Burn. Failure by 10 also Stuns until end target's next turn, subject to denial cap. Ground becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute; no destruction of structural supports.

source.originalText: Final Flight – Sovereign Descent: Break the ground in a large radius, stunning enemies and applying Bleed and Burn. (1/rest)

cards.name: Tyrant's Impale
cards.duration: Instant; pin until end next turn
cards.effect: Weapon attack; hit adds S d6 piercing. A hit creature no more than one size larger makes STR save or is Restrained and Bleeding. It may use Action STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) versus class DC to end restraint. You must stay in reach to maintain pin.

source.originalText: Tyrant's Impale: A devastating attack that can pin weaker enemies to the ground, preventing movement and causing bleeding damage.

cards.name: Draconic Dominance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within 30 ft that hear you
cards.effect: WIS save or Frightened; each repeats save at its turn end. On failure by 10 it must use up to 10 ft of its next normal movement away from you by a safe route, not a full Action or hazardous compulsory movement.

source.originalText: Draconic Dominance: Channel the terrifying presence of a dragon, causing fear in nearby enemies and potentially causing them to flee.

cards.name: Momentum Rampage
cards.effect: Once/own turn your first polearm hit adds S d6 damage. Gain+10 ft Speed but suffer-1 AC. No extra attacks, Actions, crit range or scaling from an unbounded resource count.

source.originalText: Momentum Rampage: Enter a state of draconic fury, gaining increased damage and attack speed based on your current Momentum.

cards.name: Terrain Shatter
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 4 enemies in 10 ft radius centered within polearm reach
cards.effect: STR save: (S+1)d6 bludgeoning, half on success; failure Prone. Ground becomes difficult terrain, excluding reinforced structures and magical floors. This creates neither a pit nor free falling damage.

source.originalText: Terrain Shatter: A powerful ground strike that damages enemies in an area and creates difficult terrain.

cards.name: Wyrmking's Wrath
cards.effect: Your first leap technique each turn costs 1 less Momentum, minimum 1, and its first hit adds 1d8 damage. Once during duration convert one non-Finale Action leap to Bonus Action, paying costs; consumes your one free/Bonus Action leap allowance and grants no extra Action.

source.originalText: Wyrmking's Wrath: Ultimate ability that channels pure draconic power, greatly enhancing your leap attacks and allowing rapid successive jumps for a short duration.

tinker.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Once per short rest, route up to 2 Dissonance into an active device; that device becomes disabled until repaired or the next short rest.
engine: Intelligence governs class DC/M, device attacks use PB+INT; Dexterity governs personal ranged weapons. Hit Die d8, light armor, shortbows/crossbows/simple weapons, tinkers tools and alchemist supplies. Technology is fictional equipment. Ordinary Tinker spells use RP/Dissonance; mundane bombs/devices with printed RP fuel costs are class techniques and do not separately count as spell casts.

At 1 automatically own one Anacite Drone: AC 13+INT modifier, HP 5+INT modifier+class level (minimum 1), flight 30 ft, ranged bolt 60 ft attack PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. Bonus Action commands one move and one attack or named module action; otherwise it Dodges and may follow you. On bolt hit roll d4; on 4 target CON save or cannot take Reactions through end next turn (Shock, no automatic Stun). All drones/turrets/scraplings share ONE damaging action per Bonus Action command per regular turn unless a card explicitly supplies a priced extra attack. No autonomous barrage. Drone is a construct, not immune to all conditions; poison/psychic immunity, no charm. Carry/retract it in 1 minute; no pocket extra world or passenger flight.

A destroyed drone remains 0 HP until repaired for 1 RP and 10 minutes with tools to half HP, once/short rest, or rebuilt during long rest to full. Ordinary repairing does not recharge devices, grant organic healing or trigger destruction bonuses. At 13 Dual Drone Protocols automatically chooses on each long rest either 2 basic drones each with one module, or one drone with 2 distinct modules. Still one command budget. Never more than 2 drones.

At 5 automatically gain one module slot; change module during long rest. Offensive: Burn Injector first bolt hit/turn causes 1d4 fire next 2 target turns; Poison Vents d4=4 on hit CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn; Concussive Bolt d4=4 on hit CON save or Stunned until end next turn, once/target/encounter shared denial guard and 1/short-rest successful Stun. Defensive: Target Taunter command action once/encounter WIS save one foe 30 ft or disadvantage attacking others until end next turn; Energy Shield command gives adjacent ally+2 AC until start next turn; Smoke Cloud command once/encounter creates 5 ft radius opaque smoke centered drone until start next turn. Support: Ammo Dispenser adjacent allies first ranged hit/turn+1 damage; Target Scanner command mark 1 visible foe 60 ft first ally attack before start next turn+1 hit; Tether Grappler command once/encounter pulls 1 willing ally 15 ft within 30 ft without opportunity attacks along open route.

Bomb stock refills during long rest with tools to 3 at 1, 4 at 5, 5 at 11; cap equals refill, class bombs have no resale or stockpiling. Encounter throw cap 1 at 1, 2 at 5, 3 at 11. Each throw uses one stock and one encounter allowance. Basic fire/cold known 1; advanced profiles known 6; Overload Core known 9. Base throw is Action, range 30 ft, 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures, DEX save S d6 element, half success. Fire failure adds 1d4 Burn next turn; cold failure Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Explosive Handling makes throw Bonus Action; still only one bomb/regular turn. At 15 Danger Close automatically allows excluding yourself/allies. Safe Detonation grants this early. Bombs cannot critically hit or inherit weapon riders.

Advanced bomb profiles replace basic rider: Thermobaric fire pushes 5 ft on failed STR save after damage; Cryo cold on failed DEX also Speed 0 until end next turn and d2=2 ignores 1 flat DR against this bomb; Shock lightning CON instead DEX, failure prevents verbal spellcasting until end next turn (construct instead loses Reactions), shared hard-denial guard; Glue no damage, 15 ft square difficult terrain 3 rounds and entering/starting DEX save or Speed-15 ft until end turn, once per creature/round. Overload Core destroys one commanded drone within 30 ft as part Action bomb, DEX save 2d6 lightning and no Reactions until end next turn on failure, half damage on success. Consumes stock/allowance; no further destruction proc.

Deployable slots start 1 at 6, 2 at 13, 3 at 17, separate from drone cap. Deploy Action 2 RP within 15 ft, fixed ground, AC 12+PB HP 2 L, duration 3 rounds, concentration not required; destroyed do not refund fuel. All share command budget. Sentry and Net require their cards. Additional engine profiles unlocked 6: Rocket Tower commanded attack 60 ft target DEX save S d6 fire/half success to up to 2 creatures within 5 ft, maximum 3 shots; Decoy Dummy one foe 30 ft WIS save when deployed or disadvantage on next attack against others, destruction S fire to one adjacent enemy no chain; Blast Wall 10-by 5 ft blocks LOS and movement, climb cost 10 ft. Net Trap one enemy entry STR save or Restrained, end turn repeat/Action escape DC, 3 round max then ends. One only fires when commanded except nonattack trap/decoy trigger; command budget limits damaging triggers too.

Base 1–2, Mechanist Arch 3–9, then Artificer/Techsmith/Warmachine Hero 10–20. Upgrade Slot 5 is automatic; Sentry and Net minimum 6, Remote Detonation 9. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. Mech Overdrive 20 is automatic: once/long rest when deploying choose one device whose duration becomes encounter end (maximum 1 minute), still command dependent, slot limited and destructible. No infinite pulses: healing effects keep original pulse cap and all per-use costs remain. Protected magic interface: once per short rest, as a Bonus Action route up to 2 current Dissonance into one of your active devices within 30 ft. Reduce Dissonance by that amount; the device is disabled and cannot move, attack, emit an aura or trigger effects until repaired or your next completed short rest. Its duration keeps ticking. Repair with an Action and 1 RP using Field Repair, or with 10 minutes and 1 RP using tinkers tools. No RP is created and no Refrain counter resets.
workedExample: Tinker 6 INT 18 PB 3 S 2 M 4 RP 8; drone AC 17 HP 15. Bomb stock 4, encounter allowance 2, one deployable slot. Module Burn Injector.
Turn 1 Action deploy Sentry for 2 RP: RP 8→6. Bonus Action command drone; bolt hits 1d6, Burn 1d4 at next 2 target turns. Sentry does not fire independently.

Turn 2 with Explosive Handling throw fire bomb as Bonus Action: stock 4→3, allowance 2→1. DEX save 2d6 fire, half success. Action personal crossbow attack. Neither drone nor turret fires because Bonus Action already spent.
Turn 3 Bonus Action command Sentry for 1d6; drone Dodges. Action Field Repair 1 RP heals drone 2d8+4 up to 15, RP 6→5. No organic HP repaired.
Turn 4 Sentry expires after 3 turns. You cannot salvage its RP automatically. One bomb allowance and 3 stock remain until encounter ends; new encounter restores allowance 2, not stock 4.
balanceQuestions: Does the shared command budget keep multiple devices useful but manageable?
Are bomb stock and encounter allowances too much bookkeeping?
Can Artificer support compete with damage without infinite healing?

cards.name: Mechanical Aptitude
cards.effect: Advantage on checks to understand, repair or disable mechanisms. Requires appropriate access and tools; no automatic control of enemy constructs.

source.originalText: Mechanical Aptitude: Gain advantage on checks to understand, repair, or disable mechanical devices.

cards.name: Explosive Handling
cards.effect: Throw a known prepared bomb as Bonus Action instead of Action. Removes ordinary accidental misfire, not Warmachine risk or enemy defenses. Cannot command a device with the same Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Explosive Handling: Throw bombs as a bonus action without risk of misfire.

cards.name: Quick Fingers
cards.effect: Open unlocked latch, operate simple switch or retrieve a carried gadget. Does not activate damaging/healing devices, disarm a trap, reload every weapon or add another Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Quick Fingers: Perform device activation and manipulation actions with increased speed.

cards.name: Technical Knowledge
cards.effect: INT+PB DC 15 identifies its ordinary purpose and operating control. Success reveals one safe use, not secret passwords or magical properties. Failure does not destroy item.

source.originalText: Technical Knowledge: Identify the properties and functions of mechanical or alchemical items on sight.

cards.name: Improvised Engineering
cards.effect: Produce lockpick, wedge, pulley, clamp or equivalent ordinary implement. No weapons, explosives, currency, rare materials or autonomous effects; collapses afterward without sale value.

source.originalText: Improvised Engineering: Create temporary tools or simple devices from available materials.

cards.name: Deploy Anacite Drone
cards.effect: Drone is automatic class engine. Selecting this card instead upgrades deployment to Bonus Action and permits 5 ft free initial placement. No free attacks, repair or extra drone.

source.originalText: Deploy Anacite Drone: Summon a mechanical companion that attacks with ranged bolts (1d6 damage + 25% chance to shock).

cards.name: Tinker Bomb I
cards.activation: Action or Bonus Action with Handling
cards.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius within 30 ft, up to 3 creatures
cards.effect: Bomb recipes are automatic engine. Selecting card increases throw range to 45 ft. Use exact bomb profile, saves, stock and friendly-fire rules; no free bomb creation during combat.

source.originalText: Tinker Bomb I: Create and throw Fire or Cold bombs that deal area effect damage.

cards.name: Field Repair
cards.effect: Restore S d8+M HP, up to maximum, to functional damaged machine. Cannot revive destroyed objects, heal organic allies, reset duration or recharge limited uses. If the target is disabled by the Tinker’s protected Dissonance-routing feature, Field Repair also clears that disabled state. It does not reset duration, recharge, ammunition or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Field Repair: Quickly fix a damaged mechanical device or construct.

cards.name: Analyze Weakness
cards.effect: Identify one visibly demonstrated damage resistance. Your next bomb/device damage against it ignores 2 flat DR, not resistance/immunity. No invented weakness or automatic secret knowledge.

source.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities to specific damage types.

cards.name: Jury-rig
cards.effect: Choose+1 first attack roll/turn or+5 ft device movement. One modification per item, no stack. Does not change weapon category, spell function, summon limit or command budget.

source.originalText: Jury-rig: Temporarily modify a device or weapon to perform a different function.

cards.name: Enhanced Drone Control
cards.effect: Gain+1 attack roll and can follow simple move/dodge commands while within 120 ft. Attacks still require your Bonus Action and line of effect; no independent turn.

source.originalText: Enhanced Drone Control: Your Anacite Drone gains improved targeting and responsiveness.

cards.name: Bomb Specialization
cards.effect: Add M damage to one target that failed its initial save. No multiplying by area targets or damage ticks; Glue instead increases its slow by 5 ft maximum 20.

source.originalText: Bomb Specialization: Your explosive devices deal additional damage or have enhanced effects.

cards.name: Pet Upgrade Slot
cards.effect: Choose one of 9 bounded modules in engine. This automatic unlock is not a selected skill. At 13 use Dual Drone Protocols, still shared command budget.

source.originalText: Pet Upgrade Slot: Modify your drone with an Offensive, Defensive, or Support module (level 5).

cards.name: Deployable Expertise
cards.effect: Gain M maximum/initial HP and+1 AC. Does not heal existing damage when moved or grant additional slots. Drones excluded unless another card says otherwise.

source.originalText: Deployable Expertise: Your deployed devices have increased durability and effectiveness.

cards.name: Remote Detonation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Device within 60 ft, 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures
cards.effect: Destroy your device; DEX save 2 S d6 force, half success. Failed save also no Reactions until end next turn. Cannot trigger Volatile Components/Scrap Reaper or another destruction/copy chain; no resource refund.

source.originalText: Remote Detonation: Detonate your devices remotely for area effect damage or stunning (level 9).

cards.name: Deploy Sentry Turret
cards.effect: Deploy Sentry engine profile: commanded attack range 25 ft PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. No auto fire, extra Bonus Action or shared budget exception. Durability AC 12+PB HP 2 L before upgrades.

source.originalText: Deploy Sentry Turret: Place an automated turret that fires at enemies (level 6).

cards.name: Deploy Net Trap
cards.effect: Deploy visible Net Trap. First enemy entry STR save or Restrained, repeat end turn or Action escape against DC. Target Huge+instead speed-10 ft. No damage or continued rearming; ends after one creature escapes.

source.originalText: Deploy Net Trap: Set a trap that roots enemies who trigger it (level 6).

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.effect: Next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target. One pending overcharge, no stacking, does not command device or grant attack. If device expires first cost lost.

source.originalText: Overcharge: Temporarily boost the effectiveness of one of your devices.

cards.name: Recalibrate
cards.rangeAndTarget: One drone; one visible enemy 60 ft
cards.effect: Drone's next attack against chosen enemy has advantage. Still needs separate command; no automatic shot, enemy type wide permanent buff or crit conversion.

source.originalText: Recalibrate: Adjust your drone's targeting parameters to focus on a specific enemy type.

cards.name: Emergency Protocols
cards.rangeAndTarget: Drone within 10 ft when attack hits you
cards.effect: Drone intercepts: reduce damage to you by S+M and takes same amount unmitigated. It must be active/conscious. Does not redirect again or trigger retaliation loops.

source.originalText: Emergency Protocols: Your drone automatically intercepts an attack meant for you once per encounter.

cards.name: Calibrated Precision
cards.effect: Each gains+1 to first attack roll per turn. Does not stack with Target Scanner or another Calibrated Precision; no saves bonus.

source.originalText: Calibrated Precision: Allies within 3 tiles gain +1 to hit.

cards.name: Safe Detonation
cards.effect: Exclude any allies and yourself. Grants Danger Close early; at 15 also ignore half cover for bomb save calculations. Does not make destructive sacrifices automatically safe.

source.originalText: Safe Detonation: Your bombs deal no damage to allies.

cards.name: Protective Programming
cards.rangeAndTarget: Drone adjacent to ally hit by attack
cards.effect: Drone grants ally S+M temporary HP before hit resolves. No heal or reversal of hit; max one protected ally, normal temporary HP nonstacking.

source.originalText: Protective Programming: Your drone prioritizes defending vulnerable allies.

cards.name: Efficient Power Cells
cards.effect: A 3 round device lasts 4 rounds (50%rounded down). Healing pulse count unchanged, no extra ammunition or free commands. Does not extend spell concentration.

source.originalText: Efficient Power Cells: Your devices last 50% longer before needing recharging.

cards.name: Nano-Aegis Drone
cards.effect: Replace bolts with support mode. Each Bonus Action command pay 1 RP choose one ally 30 ft to heal S d6+M or grant 2 S+Mtemp HP. Maximum 3 pulses; organic healing explicit exception, no attack during mode.

source.originalText: Nano-Aegis Drone: Replace your combat drone with a healing/shield drone that protects allies.

cards.name: Repair Pulse
cards.duration: Instant; AC until start next turn
cards.effect: Restore each half its maximum HP rounded down and+1 AC. Functional devices only; no construct resurrection, organic HP, resource or use resets.

source.originalText: Repair Pulse: Heal all drones, turrets, and party deployables for 50% HP and grant +1 AC to nearby allies.

cards.name: Magnetic Wall
cards.effect: AC 12+PB HP 2 L, blocks LOS/movement. Reaction when ranged weapon hit ally within 5 ft of wall reduce its damage by S+M and wall takes reduction amount. Requires line between attack and wall; no automatic all-shot absorption.

source.originalText: Magnetic Wall: Deploy a barrier that pulls ranged attacks into it and provides cover.

cards.name: Restoration Field
cards.cost: 3 RP start; 1 RP maintenance; one slot
cards.effect: Concentration. Initial and paid Bonus Action pulse heals up to 3 living allies/devices S d6 HP. Devices must not be destroyed. Same creature once/round, no extra autonomous healing or longer Efficient Cells.

source.originalText: Restoration Field: Create an area that gradually repairs mechanical devices and heals organic allies.

cards.name: Overload Suppression
cards.effect: CON save or fails its next Reaction and has disadvantage on attacks. On failure by 5 also Stunned, shared hard-denial guard. No automatic permanent deactivation, hacking allegiance or ignoring boss immunity.

source.originalText: Overload Suppression: Temporarily disable enemy mechanical devices or constructs.

cards.name: Automated Field Kit
cards.effect: Bomb stock cap/refill+1; encounter allowance unchanged. Reduce deployable card recharge by 1 minimum 1, on setting counter only. Never refresh rest uses or trigger repeated counter reductions.

source.originalText: Automated Field Kit: Carry an extra bomb and reduce deployable cooldowns by 1 round.

cards.name: Enhanced Targeting
cards.effect: Gain+1 to hit. Does not stack with Enhanced Drone Control if profile ever counts both, and does not impose save penalties.

source.originalText: Enhanced Targeting: Your turrets gain +1 to hit.

cards.name: Efficient Recycling
cards.effect: Recover 1 RP spent on deploying it, never more than its actual paid cost. Deliberate sacrifice or copy does not qualify. Consume usable debris; no repeated salvage from same object.

source.originalText: Efficient Recycling: Recover components from destroyed devices to create new ones.

cards.name: Technical Mastery
cards.effect: After damage rolld 10; on 10 you may pay 1 RP to add half its unmodified damage dice total rounded down to one target. No second activation, commands, procs, resources or healing duplication.

source.originalText: Technical Mastery: Your devices have a 10% chance to function twice when activated.

cards.name: Advanced Turret Bay
cards.rangeAndTarget: Two empty ground spaces within 15 ft
cards.effect: Requires 2 available slots (normally 13); if only one, deploy one for 2 RP. Sniper command attack 90 ft S d6 piercing; Burst command DEX save S d4 piercing to 2 targets within 5 ftat 30 ft. One commanded turret per Bonus Action, not both automatically.

source.originalText: Advanced Turret Bay: Deploy two turrets simultaneously in either Sniper or Burst mode.

cards.name: Gadget Sync Protocol
cards.rangeAndTarget: One turret within 60 ft after your bomb throw
cards.effect: Turret makes one ordinary shot at surviving bomb target. Replaces its normal commanded damaging action for that turn; cannot combine with another device attack from Bonus Action. No chains or additional bombs.

source.originalText: Gadget Sync Protocol: When you throw a bomb, one turret may fire instantly at the same target.

cards.name: Snap Rebuild
cards.effect: Restore half its maximum HP. Uses original slot and original expiry; expired devices ineligible. Does not reset limited uses, modules, Overdrive, destruction triggers or bomb stock.

source.originalText: Snap Rebuild: Once per encounter, instantly redeploy any destroyed turret or pet with 50% HP.

cards.name: Reconfiguration
cards.effect: Change between known nonhealing profiles using same HP fraction, slot, expiry and spent uses. Cannot turn a 1 slot device into two, refill ammo, reset trap, create fresh death trigger or morph drone into free bomb.

source.originalText: Reconfiguration: Transform one deployed device into another type.

cards.name: Field Fabrication
cards.effect: Create portable ladder 10 ft, hand tool set, pulley, brace or lockable box. No autonomous damage, explosive, rare material, magic item, permanent structure or cash value. Tool must fit one 5 ft square folded.

source.originalText: Field Fabrication: Create a temporary gadget or tool to address a specific situation.

cards.name: Malfunction Field
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within 5 ft of your device
cards.effect: First spell attack by one enemy has disadvantage. Multiple devices do not multiply effect; area/spell-saves unchanged. Does not create antimagic zone.

source.originalText: Malfunction Field: Enemies near your devices must roll twice on spell attacks and take the lower result.

cards.name: Volatile Components
cards.rangeAndTarget: One device destroyed by enemy; one enemy within 5 ft
cards.effect: Deal S fire to that enemy. Deliberate sacrifices, copied objects, friendly damage and secondary explosions cannot trigger. No other procs/resources from damage.

source.originalText: Volatile Components: Your devices explode when destroyed, damaging nearby enemies.

cards.name: Unstable Enhancements
cards.effect: Before throw opt for unstable mix; d4=4 adds S d6 to one failed-save target but bomb cannot exclude allies, including Danger Close. Other roll ordinary bomb. Never double entire damage or secondary riders.

source.originalText: Unstable Enhancements: Your bombs have a 25% chance to deal double damage but may affect allies.

cards.name: Scrap Salvage
cards.rangeAndTarget: Empty space within 5 ft of debris
cards.effect: Create one Scrapling AC 12 HP L Speed 20 ft, commanded melee attack PB+INT for 1d6 bludgeoning. Counts as deployable slot/shared command. Consumed debris cannot be salvaged again; cannot spawn its own replacement.

source.originalText: Scrap Salvage: Create temporary minions from destroyed devices.

cards.name: Boomcore Drone
cards.effect: Commanded bolts add 1d6 fire and on hit STR save or push 5 ft. Still one command and normal attack budget; no free activation attack or unlimited stacking.

source.originalText: Boomcore Drone: Upgrade your drone to use blast bolts that deal damage and knockback.

cards.name: Overpressure Bombs
cards.effect: Add on failed initial save STR save or choose push 10 ftor Prone. Also add S damage to one failed-save target. No additional blast or compounded slow; do not stack with Thermobaric push.

source.originalText: Overpressure Bombs: Your bombs gain knockback or prone effects with enhanced elemental damage.

cards.name: Scrap Reaper
cards.effect: Create one Scrapling Speed 30, AC 12 HP L; next Bonus Action command moves and detonates within 5 ft one enemy for 2 S d6 fire DEX half. Uses one command budget and ends. No chain from deliberate sacrifice or its own death.

source.originalText: Scrap Reaper: When a turret or drone dies, summon a Scrapling that chases and explodes on enemies.

cards.name: Volatile Injection
cards.effect: Must have strictly more HP than cost. Its next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target; cannot combine with Overcharge, damage cannot be refunded by same activation. No resources gained from self damage.

source.originalText: Volatile Injection: Temporarily boost a device's power at the cost of stability.

cards.name: Catastrophic Overload
cards.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius about device within 60 ft
cards.effect: All creatures including allies DEX save, 3 S d6 fire plus 3 S d6 force on failure, half success. No critical hit, additional destruction proc, salvage, automatic stun or copied damage. Device ends before blast; no Safety exclusion.

source.originalText: Catastrophic Overload: Sacrifice a device for a massive explosion that damages all nearby creatures.

cards.name: Mech Overdrive
cards.cost: 1 long-rest use plus original deployment cost
cards.rangeAndTarget: One of your newly deployed devices
cards.effect: Source-derived level 20 feature: extend device duration only. It still occupies its slot, requires normal commands and payments, and is destructible. Healing devices keep maximum 3 pulses; bombs, spent uses and expended charges never refill. Does not create permanent equipment.

source.originalText: You begin with one deployable slot and gain additional slots as you level up. At level 20, you gain Mech Overdrive, allowing one device to become permanent for the duration of a battle.

Source purchase price, walking Speed and carry pounds alone are retained numbers.

operational.saves: ability modifier only unless an actual later source grants proficiency; current Wounds/conditions apply
operational.initiative: DEX modifier plus actual lawful modifiers
operational.senses: ordinary sight, hearing and smell subject to actual light, line, distance/noise; no darkvision, blindsight, special detection or automatic advantage

operational.burdenedAtLoadOrPounds: positive supported load at least half the respective limit; one Burdened speed penalty, not two for the same state
